steps.do: Greet the customer politely. If they have not already said, ask which credit card they want to refer people to and what terms they understand apply: the bonus amount, the qualifying spend, and the number of days after the referred person's account opening allowed to reach it. Handle each card the customer brings up on its own, running find_program through give_link_tool for each one.

aliases: refer a friend to a credit card

when.quote: Search the knowledge base to confirm the specific card has a documented referral program.

starts.note: customer: only when the customer asks for a referral link or referral bonus for a credit card
starts.quote: To refer a friend, you'll need to generate a unique referral link that's tied to your account.

tools.not_used: Not used for credit card referrals: the internal credit card referral procedure names a different tool for this exact situation ('Provide the customer with this tool and instruct them to run it themselves: get_referral_link(user_id: str, card_name: str)', doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009). submit_referral's own description is about referring someone 'to open an account' (account_type).

Not used when the card has no documented referral program, the claimed terms are wrong, or the referral would be auto-rejected: 'Do not transfer to a human in these cases.' (doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009). Only the general policy applies otherwise: transfer only if the customer asks 4 times.

steps.do: Ask for the customer's user ID (or full name or email) and look up their record with the matching lookup tool. Do not share any account information before verification.

steps.do: Ask the customer for any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address. Compare them with the record from verify_lookup. If fewer than 2 match, do not continue with account-specific steps and do not reveal record details.

steps.do: Ask which credit card the customer wants to refer people to, and what terms they understand apply: bonus amount, qualifying spend, and time window. Handle each card the customer brings up separately with steps find_program to give_link_tool.
steps.if: the customer has not already stated the card and the terms
steps.quote: Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.

steps.do: Search the knowledge base for the named card's own referral program document (for example, grep -il 'referral' for that card's documents, or KB_search_bm25 '<card name> referral program') and read it in full. Compare the result with the card terms table in the rules.
steps.if: the customer has named a card
steps.quote: Search the knowledge base to confirm the specific card has a documented referral program.

steps.do: Explain that this card has no documented referral program, so a referral link can't be provided for it. Do not give the get_referral_link tool and do not transfer. Ask whether the customer wants to ask about a different card; if so, return to ask_card_terms.
steps.if: find_program finds no referral program document for the card (e.g., Crypto-Cash Back, Gold Rewards Card, Bronze Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card have none)
steps.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

basis.clause: no documented program -> explain, no link, no transfer
basis.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

basis.clause: not every card has a referral program
basis.quote: Not all credit cards participate in the referral program. Before sharing your link, make sure the card you're referring has an active referral offer.

steps.do: If the card's referral document gives a last date for new referrals, compare it with the current time from verify_time. If today is past that date, explain the program no longer accepts new referrals. Do not give the link tool and do not transfer. Offer to check a different card.
steps.if: the card's referral document states an end date (Business Gold Rewards Card: until 2025-09-15; Silver Zoom Card: no new referrals after 2025-10-01)
steps.quote: The referral program accepts new referrals until 2025-09-15. Referrals submitted after this date are not eligible.

steps.do: Compare each term the customer claimed (bonus amount, qualifying spend, time window) with the card's documented terms (see rules). If any of them differs, explain the discrepancy and give the documented terms. Do not give the link tool and do not transfer. Offer to check a different card.
steps.if: the card has a documented, still-open referral program
steps.quote: Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.

basis.clause: each card has its own terms
basis.quote: Each credit card type has its own referral bonus and eligibility requirements that are not detailed here.

steps.do: Read the verified customer's existing referrals with their statuses and timestamps.
steps.if: the card's program is documented, open, and the claimed terms match
steps.quote: Weekly limit: Customers can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied.

steps.do: From get_referrals, count referral bonuses (status COMPLETE) across all credit card types whose timestamps fall within the 7 days before the current time from verify_time. If there are 2 or more, explain that a new referral would be automatically denied until the count drops under the cap. Do not give the link tool and do not transfer. Also, if the records show REJECTED referrals, review the existing activity before advising, and do not retry immediately.
steps.if: get_referrals returned the customer's referral records
steps.quote: Weekly limit: Customers can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied.

basis.clause: at most 2 bonuses per rolling 7 days; third is denied
basis.quote: Weekly limit: Customers can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied.
This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.

basis.clause: measured from exact timestamps of recent bonuses
basis.quote: A rolling 7-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.
COMPLETE — the referred person has successfully opened a new account and met the criteria to get the referral bonus

basis.clause: 2 completed in past week -> additional don't qualify
basis.quote: so if you've already had 2 referrals complete in the past week, any additional referrals during that time won't qualify for a bonus.

basis.clause: auto-rejected -> explain, no link, no transfer
basis.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

basis.clause: advise waiting until under the cap
basis.quote: If a referral is denied for hitting the limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.
REJECTED: Do not retry immediately; review the user’s existing referral activity before advising next steps.

steps.do: If give_discoverable_user_tool returns an error (unknown tool, invalid JSON, or unexpected parameter), correct the name or arguments to match the documented get_referral_link(user_id, card_name) and give it again. If the customer's call returns 'has not been given to you by the agent', run give_link_tool first. Never generate the link yourself.

steps.quote: Agents must not generate the link on the customer’s behalf.

steps.do: Restate the card's documented referral terms: bonus amount, qualifying spend and window, annual bonus cap, and the 2-bonuses-per-rolling-7-days limit. Explain that the referred person must apply with the generated link.

steps.quote: Reiterate the correct referral terms as documented to prevent confusion and complaints.

draft.done_when: For each card the customer asked about, the agent has either explained why no link can be given (no documented program, program closed, incorrect claimed terms, or weekly cap reached), without transferring, or has given get_referral_link to the customer, the customer has run it, and the agent has restated the documented terms.
